searchText: devnet is up 😄 https://dora.focil-devnet-0.ethpandaops.io/ still a few epochs to go for focil to go live Thanks a lot! <@199561711278227457> <@577788234810130432> You can see FOCIL lists shown here 😄 https://dora.focil-devnet-0.ethpandaops.io/slot/174#inclusionLists Awesome, it would be nice Dora shows why missing IL transactions are omitted, e.g. bad nonce. how's this info exposed? dora can show whatever is on the api easily, otherwise it might need different piping and if we're doing different piping i think different visuals also make sense. right now its a really verbose list of txs and i kinda don't know wtf is going on at first glance Actually that's the tricky part. I'm not sure if that info is retrievable via APIs. I haven't dug into it further. I built that IL tab but don't really think it gives us a meaningful signal tbh. Ideally, we'd want to see what were available, what were picked up for ILs, what were omitted for which reason, etc. It's a future work 😁 i see a few orphaned payloads, will you look into it jihoon? let me know if you need access to anything. in general the `panda` should be able to do everything you want https://panda-uploads-production.devops-539.workers.dev/panda/uploads/d9077b/focil-devnet-0-orphans.html
